meta.description: Welcome to the Dietitian Center — Scientific support, personalized nutrition plans and a warm, supportive approach to nutrition.

biography.fallbackHtml:
My name is Vasiliki Chyta and I am a Dietitian–Nutritionist.

I studied Nutrition and Dietetics at the International Hellenic University and trained at Hippocrates General Hospital of Thessaloniki, working with people facing eating disorders.

I continued my education in evidence-based medical nutrition and in the relationship between people and food. I now live in France and work online with people from different countries.

My own experience with food and body image led me to explore nutrition both nutritionally and emotionally, and to support people through the nutritional therapy they seek.

philosophy.fallbackHtml:
My philosophy is based on the biopsychosocial model: health and nutrition are shaped by our body, mind and environment.

I see nutrition as a reflection of our relationship with our body, emotions and everyday context—not as an isolated set of rules.

In sessions we work holistically and with a person-centered approach, drawing on cognitive behavioral therapy and adapting it to nutritional care.

The goal is not a ‘perfect diet’, but a gentle, realistic connection with the body and its needs.

I work with adults and adolescents on eating disorders, weight regulation, PCOS and hormonal disorders, clinical nutrition, intuitive eating, and metabolic and nutritional rehabilitation.
